**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include any specific behaviors or workflows.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Target User Role**
- [ ] Student / Faculty User
- [ ] Facility Administrator
- [ ] Maintenance Technician
- [ ] System Operator

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
